class Figure1613(ThreeDScene):
    AXIS_LEN   = 2.0
    BODY_AXES  = 1.8
    ELLIPSOID  = (1.6, 1.0, 0.7)
    A_POS = np.array([1.2, 0.8, 1.0])
    TILT_X, TILT_Y, TILT_Z = 0.4, -0.3, 0.5
    def construct(self):
        self.set_camera_orientation(phi=70 * DEGREES, theta=-45 * DEGREES,
                                    zoom=0.85)
        self.camera.set_focal_distance(20)
        R = (
            rotation_matrix(self.TILT_Z, OUT)
            @ rotation_matrix(self.TILT_Y, UP)
            @ rotation_matrix(self.TILT_X, RIGHT)
        )
        i_p = R @ RIGHT
        j_p = R @ UP
        k_p = R @ OUT
        O = DOWN
        ax_i = make_axis(O, self.AXIS_LEN * RIGHT, FIXED_COLOR, r"\mathbf{i}")
        ax_j = make_axis(O, self.AXIS_LEN * UP,    FIXED_COLOR, r"\mathbf{j}")
        ax_k = make_axis(O, self.AXIS_LEN * OUT,   FIXED_COLOR, r"\mathbf{k}")
        lbl_O = MathTex("O", color=FIXED_COLOR).scale(0.65).move_to([-0.25, -0.25, 0])
        fixed_frame = VGroup(ax_i, ax_j, ax_k, lbl_O)
        lbl_x = MathTex("x", color=FIXED_COLOR).scale(0.55).move_to(self.AXIS_LEN * RIGHT + [0.3, -0.2, 0])
        lbl_y = MathTex("y", color=FIXED_COLOR).scale(0.55).move_to(self.AXIS_LEN * UP + [0.2, 0.3, 0])
        lbl_z = MathTex("z", color=FIXED_COLOR).scale(0.55).move_to(self.AXIS_LEN * OUT + [-0.15, 0, 0.3])
        fixed_labels = VGroup(lbl_x, lbl_y, lbl_z)
        r_A_arr = Arrow3D(O, self.A_POS, color=RA_COLOR,
                          resolution=8, thickness=0.025,
                          base_radius=0.04, height=0.22)
        lbl_rA = MathTex(r"\mathbf{r}_A", color=RA_COLOR).scale(0.65)
        lbl_rA.move_to(self.A_POS / 2 + np.array([-0.35, 0, 0.2]))
        r_A_group = VGroup(r_A_arr, lbl_rA)
        A = self.A_POS
        ax_ip = make_axis(A, A + self.BODY_AXES * i_p, MOVING_COLOR, r"\mathbf{i}'")
        ax_jp = make_axis(A, A + self.BODY_AXES * j_p, MOVING_COLOR, r"\mathbf{j}'")
        ax_kp = make_axis(A, A + self.BODY_AXES * k_p, MOVING_COLOR, r"\mathbf{k}'")
        lbl_A = MathTex("A", color=MOVING_COLOR).scale(0.65).move_to(A + np.array([0.2, -0.2, 0.1]))
        lbl_xp = MathTex("x'", color=MOVING_COLOR).scale(0.5).move_to(A + self.BODY_AXES * i_p + 0.35 * i_p)
        lbl_yp = MathTex("y'", color=MOVING_COLOR).scale(0.5).move_to(A + self.BODY_AXES * j_p + 0.35 * j_p)
        lbl_zp = MathTex("z'", color=MOVING_COLOR).scale(0.5).move_to(A + self.BODY_AXES * k_p + 0.35 * k_p)
        moving_frame = VGroup(ax_ip, ax_jp, ax_kp, lbl_A, lbl_xp, lbl_yp, lbl_zp)
        a, b, c = self.ELLIPSOID
        u_vals = np.linspace(0, TAU,   30)
        v_vals = np.linspace(0, PI,    20)
        verts = []
        for v in v_vals:
            for u in u_vals:
                p = np.array([
                    a * np.sin(v) * np.cos(u),
                    b * np.sin(v) * np.sin(u),
                    c * np.cos(v)
                ])
                verts.append(R @ p + A)
        ellipsoid = Surface(
            lambda u, v: A + R @ np.array([
                a * np.sin(v) * np.cos(u),
                b * np.sin(v) * np.sin(u),
                c * np.cos(v)
            ]),
            u_range=[0, TAU],
            v_range=[0, PI],
            resolution=(20, 12),
            fill_color=BODY_COLOR,
            fill_opacity=0.25,
            stroke_color=BODY_COLOR,
            stroke_width=0.4,
            stroke_opacity=0.5,
        )
        lbl_B = MathTex(r"\mathcal{B}", color=BODY_COLOR).scale(0.8)
        lbl_B.move_to(A + R @ np.array([a * 0.6, b * 0.7, c * 0.5]) + np.array([0.25, 0.25, 0]))
        body_group = VGroup(ellipsoid, lbl_B)
        omega_dir = normalize(np.array([-0.4, 0.6, 1.0]))
        omega_end = A + 1.6 * omega_dir
        omega_arr = Arrow3D(A, omega_end, color=OMEGA_COLOR,
                            resolution=8, thickness=0.03,
                            base_radius=0.05, height=0.25)
        lbl_omega = MathTex(r"\boldsymbol{\omega}", color=OMEGA_COLOR).scale(0.7)
        lbl_omega.move_to(omega_end + np.array([-0.35, 0.25, 0.15]))
        omega_group = VGroup(omega_arr, lbl_omega)
        va_dir = normalize(np.array([0.7, -0.3, -0.6]))
        va_end = A + 1.4 * va_dir
        va_arr = Arrow3D(A, va_end, color=VA_COLOR,
                         resolution=8, thickness=0.03,
                         base_radius=0.05, height=0.25)
        lbl_vA = MathTex(r"\mathbf{v}_A", color=VA_COLOR).scale(0.65)
        lbl_vA.move_to(va_end + np.array([0.3, -0.25, -0.1]))
        va_group = VGroup(va_arr, lbl_vA)
        title = Text("Figure 16.13 – Two Reference Frames", font_size=28,
                     color=WHITE).to_corner(UL)
        subtitle = Text("Fixed: O-xyz   |   Moving: A-x'y'z' embedded in ℬ",
                        font_size=20, color=GREY_B).next_to(title, DOWN, buff=0.1)
        self.add_fixed_in_frame_mobjects(title, subtitle)
        self.play(Write(title), Write(subtitle), run_time=1)
        self.play(
            LaggedStart(
                Create(ax_i[0]), Create(ax_j[0]), Create(ax_k[0]),
                lag_ratio=0
            ),
            Write(lbl_O), Write(fixed_labels),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        self.play(
            Write(ax_i[1]), Write(ax_j[1]), Write(ax_k[1]),
            run_time=0.8
        )
        self.play(Create(r_A_arr), Write(lbl_rA), run_time=1)
        self.play(Create(ellipsoid), Write(lbl_B), run_time=1.5)
        self.play(
            LaggedStart(
                Create(ax_ip[0]), Create(ax_jp[0]), Create(ax_kp[0]),
                lag_ratio=0
            ),
            Write(lbl_A),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        self.play(
            Write(ax_ip[1]), Write(ax_jp[1]), Write(ax_kp[1]),
            Write(lbl_xp), Write(lbl_yp), Write(lbl_zp),
            run_time=0.8
        )
        self.play(Create(omega_arr), Write(lbl_omega), run_time=0.8)
        self.play(Create(va_arr), Write(lbl_vA), run_time=0.8)
        self.wait(1)
        self.begin_ambient_camera_rotation(rate=0.18)
        self.wait(2)
        self.stop_ambient_camera_rotation()
        self.wait(1)
        P_POS = np.array([3, 1, 1.0])
        lbl_vP = MathTex(r"\mathbf{v}_P", color=VA_COLOR).scale(0.65)
        lbl_vP.move_to(P_POS)
        self.play(Write(lbl_vP))
        self.wait(1)
